extracted.intended_audience: college students, recent graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and faculty seeking STEM internships and fellowships at national laboratories and U.S. federal agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for finding and applying to ORISE-managed STEM internships and fellowships (research, policy, technical or non-research) and for choosing opportunities appropriate to academic level and career goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program alignment with host research facility interests
rubrics_metrics.description: STEM internship and fellowship programs are closely aligned with the interests of a variety of research facilities, including those managed for the U.S. Department of Energy and other federal agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When selecting opportunities, prioritize programs that match the research or technical interests of the host facility (e.g., national labs or federal agency units) to maximize relevance and fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended outcomes of opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities listed on Zintellect aim to strengthen the scientific and technical workforce in areas of science, transfer knowledge and technology to the academic community, and support to the national commitment to science education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate programs by their stated contributions to workforce development, knowledge/technology transfer, and education outreach to judge potential career impact and alignment with your goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Zintellect searchable database
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants can find opportunities via Zintellect, a searchable database of research and non-research internships and fellowships at national laboratories and U.S. government agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Zintellect as the primary tool to discover, filter, and apply to ORISE-affiliated positions; check listings for eligibility, location, duration, and other posting details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by academic level / match program to academic status
rubrics_metrics.description: Search internships and fellowships by academic level: Undergraduate Internships and Fellowships; Graduate Internships and Fellowships; Recent Graduate Internships and Fellowships; Postdoctoral Fellowships; Faculty Research Opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the classification that matches your current academic status to find appropriate opportunities; ensure you meet any level-specific eligibility and timing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program types (research, policy, technical, non-research)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORISE connects applicants with STEM research, policy, or technical internship or fellowship opportunities (and listings include both research and non-research positions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether you seek research, policy, technical, or other non-research experience and filter listings accordingly to match career and training objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paid opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Every year, ORISE connects students, post-graduates, and faculty with paid internship and fellowship opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect compensation for ORISE-managed positions; verify pay/stipend/salary and any benefits or reimbursements in each listing before applying or accepting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ORISE GO app to manage applications and engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: The ORISE GO mobile app helps you stay engaged, connected, and informed during your ORISE experience and beyond. Use ORISE GO to search and apply for opportunities, learn about exclusive ORISE events, manage applications, accept offers, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the ORISE GO app to streamline searching, applying, tracking application status, and accepting offers; leverage it for event notifications and networking with the ORISE community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media commenting policy / acceptable use
rubrics_metrics.description: ORISE reserves the right to delete or mark as spam comments and posts on its social media pages containing any of the following: abusive, defamatory, obscene or profane language; personal attacks, threatening or discriminating language; off-topic or irrelevant information; misinformation; spam; promotion of illegal or questionable activities; promotion of a business for profit or commercial transaction; political advocacy, promotion of a political candidate, or individual campaigning for office; multiple postings of identical information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All comments are solely the responsibility of the commenter and do not reflect ORISE views; comments are not edited for accuracy. Avoid the listed content types on ORISE social channels to prevent deletion or marking as spam.
